top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new pharmacological principle, event-driven catalytic removal by induced E3 proximity, independently reproduced and reaching targets that occupancy-based inhibitors cannot. P002 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) credits the origin of each distinct mechanism, PROTACs and the cereblon-dependent thalidomide-analogue glue strand, which is the only degrader mechanism attached to approved drugs, and the citation covers both. P001 is scientifically sound but narrows the field to heterobifunctional design; P003 and P004 pair a Crews-Deshaies PROTAC prize with a second, less settled part (lipid nanoparticle attribution, KRAS covalent inhibitors), and omit the glue strand.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; collaborations in nucleotide metabolism and DNA replication are unrelated to the proposed laureates
